police.speaker: Detective Morris
police.text: Morris finds the car registered to a shell company. The record is real; the owner is not.

signal.speaker: Amara
signal.text: The depot mark matches an old shipping code Amara saw on Victor's phone.

alone.speaker: David
alone.text: The tire tracks lead away from the road and end beside a covered drain.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: David finds a brass key stamped with a mark from the old river depot. The garden gate had not been forced; someone inside opened it for Victor.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: A camera frame catches a second car leaving just before Victor. Its driver turns toward the depot and looks straight at the lens.

dialogues.speaker: Victor
dialogues.text: The camera goes dark. A voice from the depot speaker says: "You are already late."

choices.label: Ask Morris to trace the car
choices.impact: Morris can trace the shell company, but visible patrol cars could tip off its driver.
choices.response: Morris: I will check the company records quietly and put one officer at the depot road.
choices.speaker: Detective Morris

choices.label: Have Amara decode the depot mark
choices.impact: Amara can match the mark to a freight route before the rain erases the tracks.
choices.response: Amara: I will compare the stamp with Victor's old shipping records and mark the route.
choices.speaker: Amara

choices.label: Follow the driver's tire tracks
choices.impact: David can reach the covered drain first, but the tracks may lead into a trap.
choices.response: David: I will follow the tracks to the drain and send you my location before I go in.
choices.speaker: David

metadata.episode: A continuing rescue mystery; the final clue opens the next episode.
